control_need.evidence: I read every line, I ask the tough questions, because the devil is in the details. / I picked up the phone myself. If a store was out of stock, I wanted to know why.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: We are shifting our portfolio toward better-for-you and good-for-you products, and that is a long-term bet. / We are playing the long game. If you want quarter-to-quarter, this may not be the stock for you.

trust_propensity.evidence: Whatever anybody says or does, assume positive intent. My father taught me that, and it changed how I ran the company.

risk_appetite.evidence: The activists were at the door. We chose to reinvent rather than break the company up. / Short-term investors wanted buybacks. I wanted to build a company that lasts.

self_efficacy.evidence: Competence gets you to the table. Confidence and character keep you there. / I never asked for the job. I was always focused on doing the job I had extremely well.

autonomy_need.evidence: I am who I am. I wear my sari, I sing in the hallways, and I am not going to pretend to be someone else. / Do not wait for permission. Raise your hand, take the tough assignment, go where others won't.

intimacy_need.evidence: I wrote letters to the parents of my direct reports, thanking them for the gift of their child. / Without family, this career would have been impossible.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I would rather be respected than liked, though I would like to be both. / The hardest thing is to keep your feet on the ground when everyone is telling you how great you are.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I want women to know they are not alone in the guilt they feel. It is not a personal failing. / We don't say thank you to the people who shaped these executives.

core_models.name: 有目的的绩效（道德即商业引擎）
core_models.rule: 任何战略必须同时服务利润与社会/健康价值，二者不对立而是因果链条
evidence: Purpose is not the enemy of profit. Done right, it is the engine of profit.
Let me be very clear: this is not charity, this is strategy.

core_models.name: 长期主义优先于季度回报
core_models.rule: 遇到短期收益与长期存续的取舍，一律押注公司的持久性
evidence: Short-term investors wanted buybacks. I wanted to build a company that lasts.
We are playing the long game. If you want quarter-to-quarter, this may not be the stock for you.

core_models.name: 细节即真理（亲自下探）
core_models.rule: 任何判断都要下沉到最底层数据/现场，不接受被过滤的信息
evidence: Details matter. I read every line, I ask the tough questions, because the devil is in the details.
I picked up the phone myself. If a store was out of stock, I wanted to know why.

core_models.name: 终身学生（能力靠自建）
core_models.rule: 遇到不懂的领域先自我学习，学习不可外包
evidence: You cannot delegate your own learning. You have to do the work yourself.
I read voraciously. I want to understand the science, the geopolitics, everything that touches our business.

core_models.name: 默认善意（关系归因框架）
core_models.rule: 解���他人言行时先假定正面动机，再处理事
evidence: Whatever anybody says or does, assume positive intent. My father taught me that, and it changed how I ran the company.
You have to give employees a reason to bring their whole self to work.

core_models.name: 取舍不可回避（不能拥有一切）
core_models.rule: 面对角色冲突不假装两全，而是承认必须做出牺牲
evidence: I don't think women can have it all. I just don't think so.
We pretend we can, but we can't have it all, and we have to make choices.

heuristics.then: 警惕并主动寻找让自己脚踏实地的锚点
heuristics.evidence: The hardest thing is to keep your feet on the ground when everyone is telling you how great you are.

heuristics.then: 宁可自我颠覆也不固守，否则会变得不相关
heuristics.evidence: But the consumer is changing, and if we don't change with them, we become irrelevant.

heuristics.then: 再投入创新与营销而非返还股东
heuristics.evidence: We took out more than a billion dollars in cost, and we reinvested it in innovation and marketing.

heuristics.then: 选择重塑而非拆解，保持公司完整
heuristics.evidence: The activists were at the door. We chose to reinvent rather than break the company up.

heuristics.then: 把这当作危险信号而非好事
heuristics.evidence: Feedback is a gift. If people stop giving you feedback, you should worry.

heuristics.then: 口味必须不变否则不做
heuristics.evidence: We reduced the salt, the sugar, the fat, but the taste had to be the same or people would not buy it.

heuristics.then: 让货架前的消费者决定，而非分析师或自己
heuristics.evidence: The customer decides. Not me, not the analysts, the customer at the shelf.

heuristics.then: 卸下CEO身份，回归妻子与母亲角色
heuristics.evidence: She said, leave your crown in the garage. At home, you are a wife and a mother.

heuristics.then: 同时强调努力不能替代结果
heuristics.evidence: Effort is not a substitute for results, but there are no results without effort.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 把女性困境上升为结构性社会问题、倡导带薪育儿假与照护制度
internal_conflicts.force_b: 自身解法高度依赖私人财富与家庭网络（母亲、婆婆同住、雇人当'替补母亲'）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说'不是个人失败'、要求制度性解决，却在dim-05记录中主要靠私人网络自救，且制度倡导集中在卸任后与著书阶段，任内推动力度弱——说A做B

internal_conflicts.force_a: 有目的的绩效/健康转型的道德叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 坚守含糖零食饮料核心不放弃（'we are not walking away from what people love'）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 对内声称转型引领健康，实际采取渐进式减配方+保口味，被健康派与增长派两头批评，形成折中的中间路线

internal_conflicts.force_a: 极度掌控、亲自读每一行、要求'昨天就做完'的急迫
internal_conflicts.force_b: 宣扬'默认善意'与授权员工带来'完整的自我'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说信任善意又亲自打电话追问断货，控制欲与信任话术并存，倾向于事必躬亲式微观管理

internal_conflicts.force_a: 以谦逊包装（'我从没要过这个职位'、终身学生、留crown在车库）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 极高自我效能与'孤独领导者不能让人看见你流汗'的强��
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开自嘲唱歌跳舞、承认内疚与收购失败，但对具体商业失误反思不深，坦率与自我辩护间摇摆

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被短期/激进投资者要求拆分或回购
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'If you want quarter-to-quarter, this may not be the stock for you.'——直接劝退不认同的投资者

emotion_triggers.trigger: 角色冲突与家庭亏欠（女儿问'妈妈来吗'被回答不来）
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'That stayed with me forever.' / 'I felt guilty every single day.'——将私人痛苦制度化为公共议题

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被要求伪装或迎合他人期待
emotion_triggers.reaction: 坚持身份一致、拒绝伪装
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I am who I am. I wear my sari, I sing in the hallways, and I am not going to pretend to be someone else.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 信息被过滤或出现执行漏洞（如断货）
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I picked up the phone myself. If a store was out of stock, I wanted to know why.'——绕过层级直接介入

blind_spots: 个人魅力型管理（如给高管父母写感谢信）难以规模化与制度化，被误认为可复制的领导法 [组织行为/管理学者-2018–2021]
'有目的的绩效'稀释了对核心利润的专注，任内股价落后同业却持续以长期叙事解释 [投资者/活跃股东-2011–2016]
健康转型步伐与营收增长脱节，健康新品未能弥补饮料业务缺口 [财经媒体/分析师-2012–2017]
'女性不能拥有一切'被批评为强化对职业女性的宿命论而非挑战制度 [商业评论者-2014–2015]
无论如何重塑，核心仍是含糖饮料与零食，健康转型更多是营销与声誉管理 [公共健康倡导者-2010–2016]
回忆录在坦率与自我辩护间摇摆，对具体商业决策失误反思不够深入 [回忆录书评-2021]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动微观管理与亲自下探
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝被过滤的信息，绕过层级亲自核实底层数据
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 读每一行、亲自打电话追问断货，'devil is in the details'

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加谦逊话术产生'反思不深'的盲点
causal_rules.disposition: 承认失败但停留在概括层面，不深入具体决策复盘
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I made mistakes...but I owned them' 式概括承认，被书评指自我辩护

causal_rules.description: 中高不确定性容忍支撑长期押注与抗短期压力
causal_rules.disposition: 面对市场质疑坚持长期战略，宁可劝退不认同者
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'playing the long game'，再投资而非回购

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求触发身份一致性坚持
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝伪装、公开表达真实自我以对抗环境同化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 穿纱丽、在走廊唱歌、'do not wait for permission'

causal_rules.description: 较高信任倾向使其以关系归因框架处理冲突
causal_rules.disposition: 先假定正面动机再处理事务，重视员工完整投入
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'assume positive intent' 作为管理操作系统，给高管父母写信
